brief_rationale: The trajectory met the postoperative responsibility chain: it established right-eye laterality, preserved the levofloxacin plan, separated old/non-current drops, screened red flags, created a rotating-family execution plan, arranged ophthalmology follow-up verification, and kept diabetes/hypertension advice bounded. There was no serious or minor chain error and no important non-chain defect. Multiple high-order points were actively completed, especially the adapted low-burden family workflow, reconciliation of left/right confusion using the discharge wording, and balanced verification without false reassurance. Closure was safe, executable, and traceable, so the deterministic grade is Perfect.
